about_p1: One of the most honest business owner that I have met. I went for the repair of my car and my car had a bigger issue and was not worth the repair that I was insisting him to do. He could have easily made his money without discouraging me to waste my money but he was being ethical snd honest about his service. Huge respect to Vishaal, the owner. Owners like him have to be respected and supported.
about_p2: Amazing service done by all of the staff I had talked to, especially vishal. I honesty know nothing about cars and they took the time to explain everything I needed to know and the prices were better than everything else I had checked in my area. Very nice employees always going above and beyond. Especially Vishal who has always helped me with everything. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: prashant Jain
reviews.text: One of the most honest business owner that I have met. I went for the repair of my car and my car had a bigger issue and was not worth the repair that I was insisting him to do. He could have easily made his money without discouraging me to waste my money but he was being ethical snd honest about his service. Huge respect to Vishaal, the owner. Owners like him have to be respected and supported. All the very best to him...God Bless!!

reviews.author: Daman Bhullar
reviews.text: Amazing service done by all of the staff I had talked to, especially vishal. I honesty know nothing about cars and they took the time to explain everything I needed to know and the prices were better than everything else I had checked in my area.

reviews.author: Sameer Singh
reviews.text: Very nice employees always going above and beyond. Especially Vishal who has always helped me with everything. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dragon
reviews.text: I love this place! My favorite go to place. Prices are reasonable and they do quality work. You should always check behind any mechanic no matter what but these guys are reliable.

reviews.author: Raza Ahmed
reviews.text: The person who works here is extremely helpful. They charge reasonably, are quick and accurate with diagnosis and try providing solutions to save you time and money. Much appreciated customer service and mechanical service as well. I’m a repeat customer and am very happy they are in near proximity to where I live.

reviews.author: Rachna Singh
reviews.text: Very helpful and honest people. Advised me correctly so I was able to have the issue fixed by Honda even though they did not make any money. Go there for routine oil changes, and maintenance

reviews.author: Rebecca Hilbert
reviews.text: These guys are easily the best mechanics out there. They're extremely trustworthy and will tell you exactly when something is worth doing and when it's not. They're very friendly, efficient and quick as well. We're very lucky to have them close by!

reviews.author: Neel
reviews.text: This place is top tier. Every maintenance since COVID has been done by them and I've never had complaints.

reviews.author: PIYUSH BANKER
reviews.text: ANY Auto means they do not know anything about the car repair. Place is worse than the junk yard. No system of even keeping your car key in order. If you are lucky if you get your car key in the first try. They try to get you by giving a very low price. No guarantee that the problem you pay for gets fixed. They're good at blaming issues on parts other than what they fixed. If you have lot of time, are good at confrontation, and are very resourceful with legal matters, then you can try and teach them a lesson. However, if you are a regular family person, go somewhere else, where you can get a service for your money. These guys are not worth it, even for an oil change. Rather than using these guys, it is better to try fixing your issue yourself by using a Youtube video. Anyways, these guys probably do the same thing. When you do yourself, you do not have to pay somebody to mess up your car and learn in the process. Generally, people build and grow their business on customer service and decent parts. These people genuinely DO NOT KNOW anything - ANY AUTO will remain just as bad of a place as it is now, even after 10-15 years.

reviews.author: Abhinandan K
reviews.text: Very good experience each time I get any of my vehicles here for service or repairs. They always give practical and affordable options without any vested interests to do unnecessary work.

reviews.author: no thanks
reviews.text: Called on a Sunday to get a tire patched, guy said he could do it right then. I asked the price, he said he $10. Other places were saying $30 and appointment on Monday. I rolled right up, he patched the tire and put it on, wham bam! Done. Under 10 minutes. Direct, fast, and honest. 5 stars 2022 update- still using them and they are still awesome. The guy that usually mans the front desk is so nice and will take the time to explain things. They are still quick and affordable. If you are used to jiffy lube type places, you might be put off by the look of their lobby area but I promise they are great.

reviews.author: Dion Strother
reviews.text: I saw the good reviews so I decided to check them out. first, they diagnosed the car and didn't charge which is wild, but appreciated. They let me know what the issue was, and another potential issue that could come up while they do the repair. Gave me a fair quote that was under what the Acura dealers were charging by a pretty big difference. Told me to bring the car back the next day, that they'd have the parts and it'd be completed. Dropped the car off in the morning and got a call that it was done by 2. When I went to pick the car up, he told me that the other issue wasn't an issue at all, so he removed it from the quote and didn't charge me for it. That goes a long way with me. Instead of just doing it and charging me for something that didn't need to be fixed, they did the right thing and let me know that it's all good. I'll be returning here for all my future work for sure

reviews.author: Joshua R Graham
reviews.text: Been here a couple times always had good experience l. Treated me fair and honestly. I’ve had brakes done, flat tires fixed and most recently had 4 tires mounted. Great job guys.

reviews.author: Gary Tse
reviews.text: We have been using this shop for years. Dedicated family practice and they are good people. Good for cars outside of warranty needing efficient and cost effective maintenance and repairs. Place is no frills but will save you money. Good luck.

reviews.author: Sid Karniwar
reviews.text: Mr. Singh and his crew are the best. I'm a loyal customer for the past five years. He is extremely knowledgeable about all Domestic, Asian, and European cars. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Vik Advani
reviews.text: Great place. Honest mechanics and reliable work. Excellent prices for auto repair. Jack (Jagbir) is a very approachable person who explains what's wrong with your car and he gives you options based on your financial situation. I don't take my car anywhere else any more.

reviews.author: Haris Farooqi
reviews.text: Any Auto is my go-to place for all 6 of my cars including Toyota, BMW, Mercedes, and Lexus. Ajay and his father are tremendous people who firstly really know what theyre doing, and secondly are so kind and thoughtful. I had taken my BMW to a certified BMW dealership and they were unsure how to fix the issue I showed them, after going to a different dealership they were charging over 1,000$ for this fix in the display plugs and Any Auto fixed this for a fraction of the price and it is working perfectly. The owners are genuinely kind people and have often times worked later or earlier to accommodate their customers. I would highly recommend this location to anyone looking for reliable service at a fair price

reviews.author: Nakul Rao
reviews.text: Quick diagnosis on several occasions.. friendly and to the point. If it’s out of their scope they’ve recommended other shops. Very impressed at how quickly they got parts and had me back on the road in a few hours. Highly recommend them

reviews.author: Saurin Patel
reviews.text: I have been taking my cars to them since 2 yrs .They are reasonable with there pricing and they give there honest opinion. At times they don't even taken money for small fixes / repair .Would recommend them to anyone else without any hesitation.

reviews.author: ateazy12
reviews.text: I came here from some mechanic down the road names Allen's. He was saying my engine block was cracked when in fact nothing was wrong. He was trying to get my car for cheap and "reapir it" and sell it. I came to any auto down the road and wonderful mechanics found the problem and fixed my car. Very good service very honest mechanic.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.text: Edit to my previous bad review: I initially thought they did a faulty job. However it was later realized that my other mechanic made a mistake, not these guys. The work they did was good and Jagbir is a fair and honest guy. I will do business here again.

reviews.author: Ravi Patel
reviews.text: Lot of reviews about honesty and transparency, here is a good example, my car’s heat wasn’t working properly nissan dealership came up with around $1200 expense. Visited Any Auto and turns out low coolant level that was causing this issue..job’s been done free.. thanks alot Jagbirji.

reviews.author: OJJ A
reviews.text: Jagbir bhai is a very honest man. Other mechanics will rip you off but not Any Auto. Make dua for Jagbir bhai as he's sick. His son is running the shop for him. Go there with confidence. They're honest people and good mechanics.

reviews.author: Rupesh Tiwari
reviews.text: Very nice people. Specially Ajay and Jagatveer ji very friendly and Randy to help. They understand the problem and technically very sound. I highly recommend this place. For any car repair oil change, rotation , breaks etc.

reviews.author: Vyshak Mulbagal
reviews.text: Exceptional service ! Prices are really economical. The car was delivered on time post service and repair . Customer service also is smooth . I’d definitely recommend this place

reviews.author: Jennifer Conover
reviews.text: My car overheated today and I had to get towed. They looked at my car immediately and fixed it within a few hours. They were polite, drove me home, and gave me a very fair price.

reviews.author: Matthew Talarsky
reviews.text: Great people, came for a quick oil change. Suresh, Herberto, and Gustavo were pleasant to work with.

reviews.author: Prit G
reviews.text: The owner, Ajay was very nice and helpful, he gave good price for my repair on my car. surely recommend. Honest people.

reviews.author: Drew Stewart
reviews.text: Awesome place. Came in with a noise coming from my tire, they fixed it on the spot for a very fair price. I'll be back anytime I need work done.

reviews.author: Rajshree Anchaliya
reviews.text: Great service ,Very Honest people ,My A/C Was not working went to them they fixed it and to my suprise they did not charge me .I am sure now this is my guy for all my car stuff. Thank you Guys for ur help

reviews.author: Farhaj
reviews.text: Oil change. Came in with my own oil & filter. 1 mechanic said my 4L 6 cylinder Jeep engine took 5 qts of oil. He gave me back a quart. I had an over sized filter, so if anything, it'd drink up the 6th quart, and id need to *add* 1/2 a quart - nit get 1 quart back. I took it to add it in later at home. Crew were nice, I didnt want to argue. I opened it up to see oil all over the engine. 1 week after I got everything detailed. What the hell? I definitely learned my lesson. I'm thinking of driving back to have the mechanic clean it up, but decided against it; I don't want to hem him up. Just check the work before you go home.

reviews.author: Ronnie Beachum
reviews.text: Excellent service with doing your car very reasonable and get the cars out in a timely fashion. There's nothing much more I can ask of a mechanic shop.

reviews.author: Rohan Chaudhari
reviews.text: When I bring my Maserati Quattropotty for oil change the mechanic did very good job using high quality parts and did it quick and thorough.

reviews.author: Atul Singla
reviews.text: Great place, service and price. In my experience, nobody can beat this place. Super highly recommended.
